predecessors.name: Gutian dynasty
predecessors.text: the city of Uruk, re-asserting itself in the Gutian period

successors.name: Third Dynasty of Ur
successors.text: Sumer: Utu-hengal's kingdom passed to 'the governor of Ur, Ur-Nammu'

ledger.x: 2154 BCE: Uruk's fourth dynasty under Ur-nigin.
2119 BCE: Utu-hengal defeats Tirigan and is 'king of Sumer'.
2112 BCE: Utu-hengal dies and Ur-Nammu of Ur takes the kingship.

wars.name: Utu-hengal's war against Tirigan
wars.outcome: Tirigan captured; Uruk's king 'established himself as the king of Sumer'.

certainty.note: A city and, for seven years, 'Sumer'; no line is given anywhere.
